headline: Jewellery stocks rally up to 5% on Dhanteras amid strong festive demand expectations
hook: Festive demand lifts major Indian jewellery stocks
summary: Shares of jewellery makers including Titan, Kalyan Jewellers, Senco Gold, and Thangamayil rallied up to 5% on Friday driven by anticipated high demand for precious metals during Dhanteras. The upswing was further supported by Titan's strong earnings and a broader recovery in the Sensex and Nifty indices. Brokerages like Axis Securities and Religare Broking note that recent gold corrections have created attractive entry levels, projecting double-digit returns heading toward next year. For retail investors, this highlights the sector's seasonal sensitivity and provides broker-backed accumulation ranges for gold and silver.
why_it_matters: Jewellery stocks gain on festive demand as brokerages outline target prices.
winners_losers: Jewellery retailers gain / bullion buyers see lower entry costs

headline: Thangamayil Jewellery reports flat net profit at Rs 59 crore for Q2 FY27
hook: Strong topline growth leaves margins unchanged
summary: Thangamayil Jewellery posted a net profit of Rs 59 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2027, remaining flat compared to the previous period. The company recorded a 41 percent increase in gold jewellery sales, reaching Rs 2,119 crore during the quarter. Retail investors tracking regional jewelry chains should note the divergence between rising sales volume and stagnant bottom-line profitability.
why_it_matters: Higher gold sales do not automatically translate to higher profits.

headline: Thangamayil Jewellery appoints two additional directors
summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. K Thiagarajan and Mr. B Rajesh Kanna as additional directors, effective November 4, 2026. This corporate governance update reflects changes in the company's leadership team. Such board-level appointments are procedural developments for listed entities. Retail investors should note this change as part of the company's ongoing administrative updates.
why_it_matters: Routine board update with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Thangamayil Jewellery reports Q2 and H1 FY27 results and board changes
hook: Half-year earnings and board changes finalized
summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited announced its financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, following a board meeting held on November 4, 2026. The board approved the un-audited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27 alongside the appointment of new directors. Retail investors tracking retail jewelry counters can review these filings for revenue and margin trends. The updates provide direct visibility into the company's operational performance during the festive-heavy period.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides valuation for retail jewellery holders

headline: HBL Engineering and three other stocks enter StockEdge RSI uptrend scan
hook: Four stocks show rising technical momentum
summary: HBL Engineering, Authum Investment & Infrastructure, SPR Auto Technologies, and Thangamayil Jewellery appeared in StockEdge's RSI Trending Up scan on October 16. The Relative Strength Index (RSI) scan tracks equities showing increasing price momentum. Technical scans help traders identify short-term momentum shifts across listed companies.
why_it_matters: Technical scanner highlights short-term momentum changes for traders.
